description: Source file implementing ApplicationContext class and related classes for managing application lifecycle states, parameters, and telemetry metrics within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: ApplicationContext
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle state, parameters, and telemetry data within the plugin.

classes.name: ApplicationLaunchParams
classes.description: Holds parameters related to launching an application, including app ID, intent, arguments, target state, and runtime configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationKillParams
classes.description: Holds parameters related to killing an application, such as force kill flag.

methods.name: setMostRecentIntent
methods.description: Sets the most recent intent string.

methods.name: setLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: setApplicationLaunchParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for launching an application.

methods.name: setApplicationKillParams
methods.description: Sets parameters for killing an application.

methods.name: setRequestTime
methods.description: Sets the request time for telemetry metrics.

methods.name: setRequestType
methods.description: Sets the request type for telemetry metrics.

methods.name: getLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: getMostRecentIntent
methods.description: Returns the most recent intent string.

methods.name: getStateChangeId
methods.description: Returns the current state change ID.

methods.name: getRequestTime
methods.description: Returns the request time for telemetry metrics.

methods.name: getRequestType
methods.description: Returns the request type for telemetry metrics.
